notes: Curated SPARQL endpoints loaded by the kgx clients (playground, flint, yas).
Endpoints marked needsProxy=true don't send CORS headers; browser clients must route through our proxy.
Adding an endpoint here surfaces it in every kgx client at once; no JS edits needed.

endpoints.label: FPKG (this server, bundled UK Parliament RDF)
endpoints.notes: Read-only Oxigraph. Public; no auth required.

endpoints.label: UK Parliament (DDP / api.parliament.uk/sparql)
endpoints.notes: Public but no CORS. Use the /api/sparql proxy (requires PROXY_PASSWORD).

endpoints.label: Wikidata (official, query.wikidata.org)
endpoints.notes: WDQS Blazegraph. Sends CORS. Rate-limited; set a User-Agent on bulk crawls.

endpoints.label: Wikidata via QLever (Freiburg)
endpoints.notes: QLever-hosted mirror. Often faster on large joins; lacks some Wikidata extensions.

endpoints.label: Wikidata via OpenLink Virtuoso
endpoints.notes: Virtuoso mirror of Wikidata. May lag the official endpoint by hours.

endpoints.label: DBpedia (dbpedia.org/sparql)
endpoints.notes: OpenLink Virtuoso. The grandparent of public SPARQL endpoints.

endpoints.label: legislation.gov.uk (invitation-only)
endpoints.notes: Per-URI RDF works without auth; the SPARQL endpoint itself is invitation-only as of 2026.
